atlas-pilot-01.title: Team Terra Architecture Atlas — ten-practice research pilot
atlas-pilot-01.coverage: Editorial pilot: two practices each in Europe, the Americas, Africa, Asia, and Oceania. Not a worldwide directory, census, ranking, or comprehensive office inventory.
atlas-pilot-01.location_policy: Professional public locations only, summarized at city or district level. No street numbers, home addresses, personal contact details, or private contacts are stored.
atlas-pilot-01.coordinate_policy: Markers are approximate GeoNames city reference points. They do not locate offices and are not surveyed city centroids.
atlas-pilot-01.coordinate_source_type: GeoNames geographic gazetteer; geographic reference only, not an architect registry.
atlas-pilot-01.status_policy: Official-page leadership or team statements are recorded as source assertions. Current operating and professional registration status are not inferred from a website.
atlas-pilot-01.attribution: Practice facts: the linked official practice/contact pages. City reference points: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/, licensed CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.

atlas-01.title: Team Terra — World Architects Atlas
atlas-01.scope: Selected public practice-office cities. Global pilot; not a complete directory, a ranking, a license check or a current location map of individuals.
atlas-01.sample_method: Purposive small sample, one selected practice and office city per country; no claim of representativeness.
